messages.author: ab8277113f65c05e
messages.subject: methylKit 0.5.4 is released
parts:
Hi all,
We released version 0.5.4. http://code.google.com/p/methylkit/
See below for changes.

In addition, methylKit software paper is published in genome biology:
http://genomebiology.com/2012/13/10/R87

We are also trying to submit to bioconductor, until that happens we
will not be able to make huge improvements in the package, but the
package will be maintained at its usual location and bugs (if they are
encountered) will be fixed.


Best,
Altuna


methylKit 0.5.4:

IMPROVEMENTS AND BUG FIXES

* Examples added to help pages

* Changes to DESCRIPTION for complying with the bioconductor guidelines

* unused "cor" option removed from PCASamples() function

* some irrelevant functions are not exported (i.e they are not public) anymore.

* getContext() looks for the correct slot name now
